items.title: What Does General Motors (GM) $550 Million Solar Push Signal For Investors?
items.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) announced a US$550 million commitment to large-scale solar projects to offset emissions from its factories. The new clean-energy program is described by GM as its largest single investment focused on lowering manufacturing-related emissions to date. Management plans to source power from multiple utility-scale solar facilities, aiming to match a sizeable share of plant electricity demand. items.title: Rare Earth Wars: U.S. General Sounds Alarm Over China's Military Leverage
items.summary: China has already used its grip on rare earths against Western factories and U.S. defense firms. Now a retired four-star general is warning it will do so again, and he's saying it as a director of the company the Army selected to negotiate a dysprosium and terbium plant on one of its own bases.
